Play the science game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · HOW PLANTS GROW

Bunny’s Plant Growth Lab

Bunny planted a seed and watched it grow! Tap the pictures in growing order: first, next, then, and last.

Tap Bunny’s plant in growing order — first to last.

The plant is fully grown!

Seed, sprout, seedling, sunflower — you numbered the whole life of a plant.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Growth sequencing is science and storytelling at once. Say the stages aloud while tapping, then spot real plants outside — which stage is the dandelion by the gate in?

Illustration note: The artwork shows the four stages out of order on purpose, with empty number squares to fill: seeds in soil, sprout, seedling, sunflower.

Prefer paper? The Bunny’s Plant Growth Lab worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
